text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but I should not treat a gain as a reason by itself to sell; consider the stock’s prospects and my overall allocation.","After buying more Stock C and D, I left them untouched through later declines. I should review positions periodically and make deliberate choices rather than assume doing nothing is always best.","My account fell nearly 9% from Period 8 to Period 10 despite earlier gains. I should manage risk through diversification and position sizing, and judge progress by the whole portfolio over time."]}
